review_kind: Eight complete pinned cloud-native package source-vetting decisions; NOT governed semantic verification
macro_findings: Eight direct-shape first-class cloud-native packages cover AWS, Azure, GCP, eBPF, OTel and Kubernetes; 17 owned source files include nine bundled references.

Every package supplies valuable technical concepts but omits action-specific authorization for live infrastructure, billed resources, sensitive observability data, or system-wide probes; reject unchanged, preserve reference methods.

The distributed-tracing bundle includes insecure collector transport and invalid short trace IDs; KEDA Kafka reference contains a questionable scaler key; BigQuery job-history query emits user_email and full SQL.
Do not equate a complete root MIT license with permissions for external dependencies or production authority. No security or behavioral execution was performed.
Eight new candidate-only cloud-devops links improve sparse domain discovery; no governed admissions or distinct eligible denominator claim.
